title: SendRRData explicit request for No_Operation service
purpose: Exercise another explicit-message parser path by wrapping a minimally encoded CIP No_Operation-style service request inside SendRRData and CPF.
expected_behavior: Parser should accept the encapsulation and CPF framing and pass the embedded explicit request onward for service dispatch or normal protocol rejection if unsupported.
constraints_preserved: Used documented SendRRData encapsulation command 0x006f and 24-byte encapsulation header.
Length field 0x0014 matches the 20-byte payload after the encapsulation header.
Used documented CPF item pairing for SendRRData: Null Address Item then Unconnected Data Item.
Embedded CIP request uses service byte 0x00 as an inferred No_Operation mapping from the plan name; this association was not explicitly verified in supplied sources.
Embedded path uses conservative CIP logical segments to class 0x02 Message Router and instance 0x01; supplied sources documented class 0x02 but not the exact path encoding template.
Zero session handle retained as a conservative stand-alone seed assumption, not as a verified requirement.
issue_safety_notes: Generated for benign parser coverage only, with no vulnerability or malformedness claim.
